problem.title: Bellman-Ford Algorithm
problem.problemStatement: Given a weighted directed graph that may contain negative edge weights, determine the shortest distance from a source vertex to every other vertex. If a negative weight cycle exists, report it.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N, M, and S. • Next M lines contain three integers u, v, and w.
problem.output: Print NEGATIVE CYCLE if one exists; otherwise print the shortest distances.
